details_hierarchical.H1:
Criterion (per scenario): PPO beats every simple baseline (paired-bootstrap CI of Δsuccess > 0, Wilcoxon p < 0.05 on penalized steps, PPO median not worse; against a baseline already at ≥ 0.98 success: Δsuccess ≥ −1 pp and significantly fewer steps) AND Δsuccess vs greedy ≥ −5 pp. Holds in 0/2 discriminative scenarios.

Excluded as degenerate (all simple baselines ≥ 0.98 success in ≤ 2 steps): S0.

- S1: PPO vs straight: Δsuccess = -0.087 [-0.139, -0.032], Wilcoxon p = 6.9e-06 → not better
- S1: PPO vs lawnmower: Δsuccess = -0.057 [-0.111, -0.001], Wilcoxon p = 0.39 → not better
- S1: PPO vs random: Δsuccess = +0.076 [+0.017, +0.136], Wilcoxon p = 3.4e-23 → better
- S1: PPO vs greedy IG: Δsuccess = +0.073 [+0.019, +0.133] (competitive if ≥ −0.05: yes); decision time greedy/PPO = 36.2×
- S2: PPO vs straight: Δsuccess = +0.007 [-0.069, +0.097], Wilcoxon p = 5.6e-06 → not better
- S2: PPO vs lawnmower: Δsuccess = +0.136 [+0.058, +0.225], Wilcoxon p = 4.6e-29 → better
- S2: PPO vs random: Δsuccess = +0.290 [+0.211, +0.379], Wilcoxon p = 3.8e-56 → better
- S2: PPO vs greedy IG: Δsuccess = +0.173 [+0.094, +0.264] (competitive if ≥ −0.05: yes); decision time greedy/PPO = 41.2×
details_hierarchical.H2:
Criterion: the advantage increases monotonically S0 < S1 < S2 and the 95% CIs of S0 and S2 do not overlap (supported); monotone or S2 > S0 without separation (inconclusive); otherwise not supported.

- S0: PPO − best simple baseline (straight) = +0.000 [+0.000, +0.000]
- S1: PPO − best simple baseline (straight) = -0.087 [-0.139, -0.032]
- S2: PPO − best simple baseline (straight) = +0.007 [-0.069, +0.097]
details_hierarchical.H3:
Criterion (per scenario): in the unseen south region PPO still beats the best simple baseline (CI > 0) and its gap to the training-free greedy reference shrinks by at most 5 pp relative to the north (training) region.

Excluded as degenerate (all simple baselines ≥ 0.98 success in ≤ 2 steps): S0.

- S1: PPO success north 0.917 → south 0.840; PPO − greedy: north +0.007, south +0.073 (relative drop -0.066); south PPO − straight = -0.087 [-0.139, -0.032] → does not
- S2: PPO success north 0.701 → south 0.707; PPO − greedy: north +0.104, south +0.173 (relative drop -0.068); south PPO − straight = +0.007 [-0.069, +0.097] → does not
